name: ai.chinamarketing/intelligence

tools.name: get_brand_visibility_snapshot
tools.description: Generate a China brand visibility snapshot with summary assessment, scored strengths and gaps, and priority actions.

tools.name: get_destination_demand_snapshot

destination.description: Destination city, market, or country to evaluate.
